# Feature Design

## Architecture

One shell proof for each task.

## Options Considered

Shell proofs; no real alternative for a fixture.

## Simplicity And Elegance Review

Two commands.

## Failure Modes And Tradeoffs

None for a fixture.

## Verification Plan

Exit codes.

## Requirement Coverage

| Requirement | Covered By |
| --- | --- |
| `R1` | the two proofs |
| `NFR1` | the status proof |
